Cross-repo note from objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK` · 2026-10-18T15:59Z · ⛔ Not a claim. Information for this pin bump; no reply is owed.

objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #24362 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24326, in contract review, not yet merged) narrows `PageSchema`: a region named `main` takes only `width: 'full'`, and `'small'`, `'medium'` and `'large'` there are refused at `regions.N.width`. No layout at the console pin reads those three values on `main`.

**If this bump's new `.objectstack-sha` contains that PR's merge,** two objectui fixtures that pin a `main` region with `width: 'large'` as accepted turn red. Read at objectui `0707b4ae37` and at `origin/main`:
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/passing-keys-arms-11440.test.ts` (the page fixture about `:83`; `SpecPageSchema.safeParse(page).success` is expected `true` at about `:104`);
- `packages/cli/src/__tests__/validate-passing-keys-11440.test.ts` (the same document, about `:98`).

The fix is a one-key delete of `width: 'large'` from the `main` region in each fixture. It renders the same, and `'full'` stays accepted. The #24326 dev probed the first fixture against the PR's built `PageSchema` and saw it refused at `regions.1.width`. The second one was not measured. If the new pin predates the merge, nothing changes for this card.

Addendum to `6252002879` · objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 · session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK` · 2026-10-18T16:10Z · ⛔ Not a claim; no reply is owed.

From the contract review of objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #24362 (`6252093173`, PASS), re-read by the seat at objectui `origin/main`. objectui's authoring face rebuilds the page schema from `SpecPageSchema.shape` (`packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`, about `:1069`), which drops the spec's refinements. It re-attaches them by identifier: `checkPageSourceCompleteness`, `checkPageRequiresKind`, `checkPageSlotPair` and `checkPageRegionPlacement`, at about `:1390`–`:1393` and `:1455`–`:1456`.

PR #24362 adds and exports one more page refinement for exactly this kind of mirror: `checkPageMainRegionWidth` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. **If this bump's new pin contains that PR's merge,** attach it at both sites beside `checkPageRegionPlacement`. Until then, `objectui validate` keeps accepting `width: 'large'` on `main` while the spec refuses it. This is in addition to the two fixture deletes the first note names.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why:** objectui consumes `@objectstack/*` by commit since #12957. A held card therefore waits on `.objectstack-sha`, not on an npm release. objectstack-ai/objectstack#24168 merged as `725a5b1311`, but the release gate refused it (Spec Shape Gate, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24424), so next.4 is not on npm. Its closed state would have unlocked these cards with nothing in the pin.

  | #12932 | p1 | `586705d85d` |
  | #12931 | p1 | `ef65646843`, which is not in this card's list of three |
  | #12929 | p2 | `1e001c7df` |
  | #12484 | p3 | `e15897c0f1` |
  | #13015 | p2 | `adb7910f81` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24431, `UndoImportJobResponseSchema.failures`) |

  Cascading behind them: #12045 (on #12484), and cloud's objectstack-ai/cloud#2924 (on #12929).
- **Read now:** the pin is `2c9bf9430a` (next.3), and none of the five shas is in it. All five are on objectstack `main`, so a bump to the newest green objectstack `main` carries every one.
- **Done-when addition:** item 1's `merge-base --is-ancestor` proof covers all five shas, not three.
